settings.heading: Is the foot callus remover safe to use?
settings.row_content: Yes, our foot callus remover is designed with safety in mind. It’s gentle on the skin but powerful enough to remove tough calluses. We recommend starting with a low setting to gauge your comfort level, and always follow the instructions for safe and effective use.

settings.heading: How does the foot callus remover work?
settings.row_content: Our foot callus remover uses a rotating roller head that gently buffs away hard, rough skin and calluses. The motorised action makes the process quick and easy, leaving your feet feeling smooth and refreshed without the need for harsh scraping or filing.

settings.heading: Can I use the foot callus remover on wet feet?
settings.row_content: For optimal results, we recommend using the callus remover on dry feet. Wet or damp skin may reduce the effectiveness of the device. After using the callus remover, you can soak your feet in warm water to further soften the skin.

settings.heading: How often should I use the foot callus remover?
settings.row_content: For most people, using the foot callus remover 1-2 times per week is sufficient to maintain smooth, soft feet. If you have thicker calluses, you may want to use it more frequently, but be sure to allow your skin time to recover between sessions to avoid irritation.

settings.heading: Maintenance & Care: How to Clean Your Device
settings.row_content: Cleaning is simple! After each use, detach the roller head and rinse it under warm water to remove any skin buildup. Dry thoroughly before reattaching. Wipe the handle with a damp cloth, but avoid getting water into the motor or electrical components.

settings.title: Step 1: Soak
settings.text: Soak your feet in warm water for 5-10 minutes to soften the skin and prepare for treatment.

settings.title: Step 2: Apply
settings.text: Gently apply the foot callus remover using smooth, circular motions on hardened areas.

settings.text: Rinse and pat dry. Enjoy silky smooth feet with visible results immediately!
